items.quote: you and the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring him before you
items.contrast: The commander is to bring Paul; the Sanhedrin is to petition the commander and receive Paul.
items.reason: The planned roles uniquely identify the commander as the person who would bring Paul. The actor-versus-petitioner distinction is meaningful, but “the council” should be replaced with the window’s term “the Sanhedrin.”

items.quote: since their land lacked nothing, they were prosperous
items.contrast: Their land’s lacking nothing is presented as the cause of prosperity, whereas living like the Sidonians describes their safety and security.
items.reason: The causal word “since” directly and uniquely supports the key. The reader must distinguish the stated cause of prosperity from nearby descriptions of the people’s circumstances.

items.quote: the king of Israel has hired the Hittite and Egyptian kings to attack us
items.contrast: The Hittite and Egyptian kings are the expected attackers; the king of Israel is understood as the one who hired them.
items.reason: The Arameans’ reported belief assigns distinct roles to the hirer and the expected attackers, uniquely supporting the key.

items.quote: I also ordered his accusers to present to you their case against him.
items.contrast: The accusers are ordered to present the case; “you” is the recipient of the presentation, and the man is its subject.
items.reason: The key is explicitly and uniquely supported, and understanding it requires resolving participant roles. However, “the addressee” is an avoidable technical label; “Who was ordered to present the case?” would be clearer.

items.quote: were priests for the tribe of Dan until the time of the captivity of the land.
items.contrast: The priesthood lasted until the captivity of the land, while the period when God’s house was in Shiloh describes how long the idol continued to be used.
items.reason: The window uniquely attaches the captivity endpoint to Jonathan and his sons serving as priests. The reader must distinguish that duration from the adjacent duration of idol use.
